private_lines.Emiliano: You manage a sales team at an office in downtown Monterrey, and you live in an apartment in the city with your partner, who is not part of this group. Your days are meetings, client calls and a long commute, and you usually unwind with a run in the evening.
private_lines.Pablo: You are a university student in Monterrey studying engineering, and you live with your parents in the north of the city. Your days are classes, library study and a part-time shift at a café, and you often stay in to study in the evenings.
private_lines.Miguel: You are a pharmacist at a pharmacy in Monterrey, and you live alone in an apartment near the centre. Your days are behind the counter, filling prescriptions and talking to customers, and you usually go to the gym after your shift.
private_lines.Ángel: You are a physiotherapist at a clinic in Monterrey, and you share a flat in the city with a flatmate who is not part of this group. Your days are patient sessions, treatment notes and a quick lunch between appointments, and you run or train in the evenings.
private_lines.Alfredo: You are a mechanic who owns a workshop in Monterrey, and you live in a house in the city with your wife and two children, who are not part of this group. Your days are repairs, customers and paperwork at the workshop, and you spend evenings with your family.
private_lines.Felipe: You are a music teacher who gives lessons at a school in Monterrey and also takes private students in the evenings, and you live alone in a small flat in the city. Your days are classes, rehearsals and grading, and you often practise late at night.
